snippet.title: sins of KALEIDO  Nintendo Switch™  Character Trailer: Orsem Helhand (Cast: Tomoaki Maeno)#shorts
snippet.description:
The latest from AmuLit! Check out the Character Trailer for sins of KALEIDO, an upcoming download-exclusive game for the Nintendo Switch™ !!

✧••┈┈┈┈••✧••┈┈┈┈••✧

❤️Orsem Helhand
CV. Tomoaki Maeno

"...I am incapable of differentiating between education and torture."

📝Profile：
A lawyer who walks in the shadow of the law. He's a skilled negotiator, as capable as he is callous.
He speaks politely with everyone, a gentle smile always gracing his features.
But his behavior is haughty and high-handed; even government officials shrivel in his presence.

He maintains a superficial decorum with the heroine, but he holds no compassion for her.
At times, he even displays a fierce desire to torment her.

✧••┈┈┈┈••✧••┈┈┈┈••✧

"Hearts, sins, despair... Gather them all."

◆Nintendo eShop◆
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sins-of-kaleido-switch/

◆X (Twitter)◆
sins of KALEIDO: https://x.com/sinsofKALEIDO
AmuLit: https://x.com/AmuLit_Global

◆Official Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english

◆Official Portal Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/switch/english/

◆Cast◆
Nobuhiko Okamoto / Kohei Amasaki / Hikaru Midorikawa / Takuya Sato / Tomoaki Maeno

◆Participating Creators◆
Director/Scenario: Ayane Ushio
Illustrator: Tana Khaki
Background Art: Shizui fen
Soundtrack: Hayato Asano
Theme Song: DUSTCELL
Development/UI: UNICO INC.

――――――――――――――

*AmuLit is Voltage Inc's new brand for console platforms.
*sins of KALEIDO is the official title for Project Code Kaleidotower, announced in 2023.
